per_valid_case.required: stable safe dedup or explicit empty unknown error failure

measurements.engineering: retained effective seeds, missing declared dependencies, nonempty scope repairs, exact source UTF8 bytes/node count, independent source numeric-literal retention
measurements.latency: Saved actual per-case component elapsed: BGE source/query encoding + literal native insertion/search + three-arm baseline/closure packing. Excludes shared source admission, forced guards and common encoder initialization; latter is also reported amortized by the worker. Oracle reports p50/p95 from17 saved observations; root records full outer initialization/cleanup wall, CPU, peak RSS and errors.
measurements.numeric_scope: Exact literal/range retention including currency/percent/sign/unit headers; no answer arithmetic or semantic numerical correctness.
measurements.peak_RSS: Linux largest child/process high-water if RUSAGE_CHILDREN; never claim simultaneous aggregate.

official_goal: Engineering acceptance establishes no official score/rank/SOTA or eligibility. Preserve submitted native104 and unused confirmation bank.

oracle_execution.command: python3 -B oracle.py --fixtures ABS_FIXTURES --raw ABS_RAW --expected-raw-sha256 SEALED_RAW_SHA256 --out ABS_UNIQUE_REPORT
oracle_execution.failure_retention: Rejection preserves raw traces/counters; no rerun or changed expected outcome.
oracle_execution.independent_graph_validation: Kahn cycle test, supplied range/hash/document checks
oracle_execution.independent_rendering: Interval sweep, exact source equality, UTF8 capacity audit

packing.admission: Whole transitive seed component admitted atomically or dropped; no orphan dependency-only output. A fitting observed component must not yield useless empty context.

budget.max_nodes: Number of selected unit IDs including overlapping annotations
budget.max_utf8_bytes: UTF8 byte length of rendered exact source text including LF separators

packing.capacity_and_missing: Dropped/overflow/empty seeds imply INCOMPLETE_UNKNOWN, never insufficient evidence. Complete annotation closure proves only declared graph closure; global evidence completeness UNKNOWN, semantic decision NOT_EVALUATED.
packing.dependencies: Supplied author annotations only. Global cycles, missing parent IDs, cross-excerpt edges, forged text/hash/range or document mismatch invalidate entire graph.
packing.rendering: Merge overlapping/touching selected intervals within the same supplied excerpt, preserve original text exactly, sort by excerpt input order then start/end, join merged spans by one LF. Source IDs are metadata, never generated rendered-text headers.

preparation.oracle_selfcheck: 22 independent oracle falsification guards executed with no candidate imports/native/model/tokenizer/gold calls; not candidate measurement.
preparation.protocol_builder_error: An initial Python-literal quoting error aborted at parse time before any protocol output write or execution; final structured JSON writer corrects preparation only.

semantic_guard_prefreeze_correction.reason: Explicitly inspect actual candidate entailment_or_insufficiency_decision and reject retrieval_miss_implies_insufficient_evidence; no candidate run or performance selection.

publication: Freeze inputs/candidate/checker/asset revisions and roles before actual execution; connected scoped GitHub CAS only. Public reviewed artifacts; no credentials/private mail/raw pages.
purpose: Qualify exact supplied-source dependency closure after actual native RuVector seed selection; avoid silent qualifier/exception/unit omission under explicit capacity. No automatic legal parsing, semantic entailment, numeric answer correctness, benchmark generalization or SOTA claim.

retrieval.empty_effective_case: seed_limit0 still actual native k>=1 and nonempty raw ranking; effective seeds explicitly [].

lexical.tokens: sets from re.findall(r'\w+',text.casefold()) on query and exact source unit

retrieval.matched_ablation: Every arm baseline(false)/closure(true) receives identical effective seeds and capacity/rendering policy; baseline scope omissions remain explicitly unknown.
retrieval.native: Actual native helper order verbatim, with no cosine/NumPy/reference replacement. k=min(max(1,seed_limit),unit_count); effective IDs=observed[:seed_limit].
